propositions: auto-deploy restarts the review-bot container mid-review, timing out the shutdown drain (45s) before the in-flight review completes (260-911s), causing a fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote that blocks automatic reconciler recovery
the reconciler re-drives only changes with NO LLM-Review vote; a fail-closed -1 veto makes the change invisible and prevents the designed recovery from working

increasing DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS from 45 to 1200 (matching review timeout) and raising stop_grace_period to 1320s allows the deploy to quiesce and wait for in-flight reviews to complete without interruption

retryable coverage gaps (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled, teardown-mid-review) must post NO vote and record an attempt, leaving the change vote-less so the backfill reconciler can re-drive it within RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS

terminal outcomes (indeterminate, finding, pass) continue to cast their respective votes; after N consecutive retryable failures on the same (change_id, revision) the system escalates by casting fail-closed -1 with an exhaustion note and emitting VOTER_ERROR
